data.raw_text:
Why US Forcing its way on india .

Read The Real reasons and how it will be disastrous why Trade Deal with USA Is 
Stuck👇 

Right now, India is under immense pressure from the US to open its agriculture and dairy markets as part of trade talks.

This isn’t a small ask. It’s a potential economic time bomb that could gut rural India.

2/
What does “opening” mean?

It means removing restrictions that currently:
– Protect Indian farmers from cheap foreign imports
– Prevent giant agro corporations from flooding our market
– Ensure basic food security via MSP and public procurement

3/
The US wants “market access.”
That means they want to sell subsidized American wheat, corn, dairy, poultry etc. to Indian consumers.

Problem ? The US government heavily subsidizes these products making them artificially cheap.

4/
If India opens its market:
– Subsidized US produce floods in
– Indian farmers can’t compete on price
– Margins collapse
– Livelihoods destroyed
– Rural distress explodes

You think farmer suicides are bad now? This would worsen them 10x.

5/
India has 120+ million farmers and millions more in the agriculture value chain.
Dairy employs over 80 million people, many of them women in rural areas.

One trade concession could wipe out generations of livelihoods overnight.

6/
And don’t forget Indian agriculture isn’t just an industry.
It’s food sovereignty.
Once foreign players control food supply, they control the country.

You think inflation is bad now ? Wait till we rely on Walmart for milk and wheat.

7/
The US and Western countries have done this before.
They’ve crushed local agriculture in:
– Mexico (post-NAFTA)
– Africa (dumping of powdered milk, rice)
– Philippines (rice import chaos)

India is next unless we draw a red line.

8/
Yes, reforms are needed.
Yes, productivity must improve.
But forced liberalization via trade deals is not reform it’s economic colonization.

It helps a few big corporations. It destroys the Indian farmer.

9/
India must resist this trap.
– Prioritize farmer welfare
– Protect local food systems
– Build self-sufficiency
– Say NO to WTO style agriculture giveaways

Let’s not trade short-term diplomacy for long-term disaster.

10/
If we open dairy and agriculture under US pressure, we’re not signing a trade deal.

11/ Last But Not The Least Russia is Big Problem for USA

We’re signing a death warrant for rural India.
